BrochureContent.Content:
DNG O'Grady Auctioneers & PJ Broderick & Co Auctioneers are delighted to present this magnificent property to the market.

Beakstown Lodge is a Georgian residence that exemplifies the finest characteristics of period architecture, combining elegant symmetry with beautifully proportioned living accommodation rich in original features. Floodlit to striking effect, the accommodation is arranged over three floors and extends to approximately 250 Sq M.

Lovingly maintained by its current owners, the property retains many of its original period details, including ornate fireplaces and working shutters, ensuring that its historic charm remains intact.

A flight of limestone steps leads to the impressive front entrance, immediately setting the tone for the elegance that lies within. Upon entering the grand reception hall, one is instantly struck by the scale, character, and refinement of this exceptional family home.

The formal drawing room and dining room are truly breathtaking spaces, ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. The drawing room enjoys a prime position to the front of the house, while a generously proportioned principal bedroom, featuring a large bay window overlooking the rear gardens, is also located on this level.

The return level and garden floor accommodate a spacious kitchen/breakfast room, together with a substantial study/home office and utility room. The lower level provides two further generously sized bedrooms and a shower room, offering flexible accommodation for family or guests.

A particular feature of the property is the detached Coach House, which presents endless possibilities for use as a gym, games room, entertainment space, studio, home bar, or creative workspace.

Approached through a gated entrance, the property opens onto a stunning courtyard and beautifully landscaped grounds. The walled gardens are thoughtfully planted with mature trees, flowering shrubs, and established borders, creating a private and tranquil setting. A perfectly positioned outdoor barbecue area provides an ideal space for al fresco dining and enjoying the evening sun.

Beakstown Lodge occupies a prominent position in one of County Tipperary's most sought-after residential locations, approximately 5 km from the thriving town of Thurles. Thurles offers an excellent range of amenities, including schools, shops, sporting facilities, and the important railway station with services to Dublin, Cork, Limerick, Waterford, and Galway. The property is also conveniently located just 10 km from the M8 motorway, providing excellent connectivity throughout the country.

Beakstown Lodge is a home of exceptional character and distinction, and one that must be viewed in person to be fully appreciated.

Property Features
• Magnificent Georgian residence retaining original period features, including fireplaces and working shutters. 
• Elegant accommodation arranged over three floors extending to approximately 250 Sq M
• Stunning formal drawing room and dining room, ideal for entertaining. 
• Spacious principal bedroom with bay window overlooking the rear gardens. 
• Flexible accommodation with two additional bedrooms, study/home office, and utility room. 
• Detached Coach House suitable for a gym, studio, games room, home bar, or entertainment space. 
• Beautiful walled gardens with mature trees, landscaped borders, courtyard, and outdoor barbecue area. 
• Prime location just 5 km from Thurles and 10 km from the M8 motorway, offering excellent connectivity.
